correctness.rationale: Reduced exact p=1 four-compartment map to probability-preserving F(a,r)=(ea+H(a)(1-a-r),ta+zr); s1 multiplier exp[-(ca+m)]<1 so nonfixed periodic states cannot have s1>0. If a0>a1 in hypothetical two-cycle, subtracting r equations gives r1-r0=t(a0-a1)/(1+z), s1-s0=(1-t/(1+z))(a0-a1); subtracting a equations requires -(1+e)Delta=H(a0)s0-H(a1)s1 >= -(1-t/(1+z))Delta for monotone H, contradiction. For exact H, H/a=c int_0^1 exp[-(ca+m)u]du strictly decreases, giving one positive equilibrium iff e+Hprime(0)>1 (the established R_tau threshold) and global extinction at/below. At endemic equilibrium J=[[A,-h],[t,z]], A=e-h+(1-e)eta with 0<eta<1; Jury factors (1-A)(1-z)+th, (1+A)(1+z)+th and 1-zA-th all positive since zA+th<=max(z,t)<1. Full transverse multiplier exp[-(ca+m)]<1. Independently verified rational nonmonotone H bump cycle exactly (1/2,9/40)<->(1/5,3/10). Does not rule out longer cycles or global supercritical convergence.
